title: WINDFRD Livescope Transducer Pole Mount for Kayak/Boat, 0 Degree Pole Mount Compatible with Garmin LVS34/32/62 and Lowrance ActiveTarget2, Includes Luminous Handle Sleeve and T-Bolt Attachment
description:
Package Includes: a 49.4" long transducer pole with 5.9" double socket arm and a 1.5" ball AMPS hole pattern base, transducer mount compatible with 0 degree LVS34/32/62 and Lowrance ActiveTarget2, luminous handle sleeve, and 316L stainless steel mounting hardware required for installation.
Immersion Depth: 28.54" to 45.45". Pole Handle: 14.11"
Adjust As You Like - 360° adjustable transducer detection direction; Adjustable depth of the transducer into the water; The ball-and-socket technology allows for smooth adjustment of the transducer pole's diving depth and angle; Quickly change the position of the holder via the T-bolt.
0-Degree Transducer Mount, Compatible with Four Models - Equipped with four 0-degree transducer mounts, compatible with Garmin LiveScope System (LVS32) / LiveScope Plus LVS34 / LiveScope XR LVS62 / Lowrance ActiveTarget 2. It seamlessly converts between Forward View and Down View in various configurations. Designed for universal compatibility, it offers multiple starboard and port-side mounting options to fit any boat setup, giving you unparalleled flexibility.
Designed for High Salt Marine Environment - Constructed of Powder-Coated Marine-Grade Aluminum and Stainless Steel Hardware. Excellent saltwater and corrosion resistance, proven by thousands of hours of salt spray testing.
Superior Compatibility - The AMPS hole pattern base with T-bolt attachment designed for track mounting systems including most integrated kayak tracks and other third party track systems. It can also be directly installed on a flat surface using self-tapping screws.
Complimentary glow-in-the-dark handle sleeve included to enhance your night fishing experience.

title: WINDFRD Custom High-Strength Carbon Fiber & Cast Aluminum Transducer Pole Mount
description:
Professional Dual-Material Build
Features a custom high-strength carbon fiber pole and a cast aluminum alloy base, offering an optimal balance of exceptional durability and lightweight performance for demanding marine environments.
Dual-Mode Versatility
Offers two mounting modes: use it with the original base, or easily switch to a universal 2.25-inch ball socket for vastly expanded compatibility with various accessories.
Extended Compatibility with WINDFRD Mount
When paired with the WINDFRD 0 Degree Pole Mount, it seamlessly adapts to mainstream transducers like Garmin LVS34, LVS32, LVS62, and Lowrance ActiveTarget 2, creating a versatile solution.
Secure & Easy Stowage
Designed for quick and convenient stowage. The pole locks securely in its stored position, ensuring a rigid and rattle-free hold while underway to save space and enhance safety.

title: Ice Fishing Transducer Pole Mount with 0 Degree Mount, Livescope Transducer Pole with Tripod Ice Mount, Compatible with Garmin LVS34, Compatible with RAM Mounts C Size/1.5'' Double Socket Arm
description:
Fits Small & Large Ice Holes - Optimized for large ice holes up to 19.27" in diameter. The transducer pole with ice mount delivers a rock-solid, secure setup even in larger holes—ensuring your sonar stays precisely positioned for reliable performance.
Adjustable Depth - Fine-tune your sonar depth from 28" to 45" Below Ice. The pole can be adjusted smoothly to your ideal depth range, even when wearing gloves, whether you're fishing in shallow or deep water under the ice. It also features 360° horizontal rotation for smooth and precise scanning control, enabling anglers to thoroughly survey the underwater environment.
Also Suitable for Open Water - Simply remove the ice fishing tripod and replace it with the open-water fishing adapter (adapter included in the package, but accessories such as arms and bases are NOT included) to use on boats, kayaks, or other fishing setups, allowing you to seamlessly transition between ice fishing and open-water angling.
Compatibility - This zero-degree livescope mount is compatible with Garmin LiveScope Plus LVS34 transducer.
Designed for High-Salt Marine Environments – Constructed from powder-coated, marine-grade aluminum, high-performance composite materials and stainless steel hardware, this mount has undergone thousands of hours of salt spray testing (including stainless steel bolts and springs) to resist corrosion in high-salt environments.
Two-Piece Portable Design for Easy Travel - Quick-detach sections make packing and transport a breeze. Lightweight and compact, it’s the go-to choice for anglers moving between ice, shore, and boat.

title: 0-Degree Transducer Pole Mount Compatible with Garmin LiveScope LVS34 LVS32 LVS62 & Lowrance AT2, Hard-Anodized Cast Aluminum, Tool-Free 3-View Mode Adjustment Trolling Motor Bracket (Solo)
description:
【Universal Compatibility for LiveScope & ActiveTarget】: Designed for professional-grade performance, our 0-degree aluminum alloy mount is fully compatible with Garmin LiveScope Plus (LVS34, LVS62, LVS32) and Lowrance ActiveTarget 2 systems. Your sonar returns, GPS position, and transducer targets are perfectly synced for unmatched accuracy, while the integrated ratcheting system ensures a stable, vertical Perspective view at any water depth.

With universal compatibility for both starboard and port-side mounting on transducer poles or trolling motors, it provides a stable, professional-grade foundation for any boat setup.

It is the ultimate "all-in-one" solution that streamlines your rig, saves deck space, and ensures your high-end sonar technology stays rock-solid in any water condition.

【Rugged Aluminum Alloy Construction & Silk-Smooth Rotation】: Built upon an integrated, high-strength cast aluminum alloy body, this mount offers professional-grade structural integrity for extreme marine environments. Paired with a precision-engineered glass fiber-reinforced polyamide clamp, the hybrid "hardness differential" design ensures ultra-smooth, bind-free 360° rotation. Rigorously tested for salt spray and UV resistance, it delivers long-term, season-after-season reliability in both freshwater and saltwater.

【Tool-Free 4-Way Rapid Adjustment】: Master dynamic fishing scenarios with our intuitive, tool-free mechanism. Effortlessly rotate your transducer into four distinct positions—Forward, Down, Perspective, and Scout—with a simple, one-twist motion. Spend less time fiddling with gear and more time on the water with this precision-engineered, quick-release system.

【Perfect Perspective & Zero-Degree Alignment】: Eliminate sonar guesswork with our proprietary zero-degree clamp geometry, which corrects common misalignment issues found in standard 8-degree mounts. Your sonar returns, GPS position, and transducer targets are perfectly synced for unmatched accuracy, while the integrated ratcheting system ensures a stable, vertical Perspective view at any water depth.

【Universal Compatibility & Multi-View Versatility】: Designed for serious anglers, this mount offers unmatched flexibility by seamlessly converting between Forward, Down, and Perspective modes. With universal compatibility for both starboard and port-side mounting on transducer poles or trolling motors, it provides a stable, professional-grade foundation for any boat setup.

title: 0 Degree Pole Mount Compatible with Garmin LiveScope Plus LVS34, Dual-Side Scan, Replaces 010-13228-03 (Double Mounts)
description:
Compatibility - This Livescope mount is compatible with Garmin LiveScope Plus LVS34 transducers. With a clamping range of 1.1" to 1.38" (28-35mm), it's versatile for both open water and ice fishing, serving as a direct replacement for part numbers 010-13228-03/0101322803.
Dual-Transducer Capability - This mount supports the installation of two transducers on a single pole or trolling motor, enabling simultaneous multi-directional scanning for a dramatic expansion of sonar coverage.
Perfect Perspective View - Stop wasting time on complex adjustments. Our mount features an integrated ratcheting mechanism that lets you quickly dial in the perfect Perspective LiveScope angle for any water depth. It keeps your transducer vertically aligned while you adjust, ensuring optimal sonar images and getting you back to fishing in seconds.
Zero-Degree - Achieve perfect sonar alignment right out of the box. Our proprietary zero-degree clamps fix the common geometry issue caused by standard 8-degree clamps. This means your sonar returns, GPS position, and transducer targets are perfectly synced for unmatched accuracy in both Forward and Down View modes, making it easy to spot fish and locate your lure.
Multi-View Switching - The most adaptable and efficient mount on the water. It seamlessly converts between Forward/Down View and Perspective View in various configurations. Designed for universal compatibility, it offers multiple starboard and port-side mounting options to fit any boat setup, giving you unparalleled flexibility.
All-Environment Durability - This real-time fish-finding mount is engineered for versatile deployment, securely attaching to your transducer pole or trolling motor. Constructed from durable Glass Fiber-Reinforced Polyamide, it is rigorously tested for excellent salt spray resistance, ensuring long-term reliability against harsh saltwater corrosion and UV exposure.
Full-Coverage Adjustments - Engineered for speed and performance. Make quick view changes without losing your sonar beam. The combination of swift ratcheting adjustments and total beam coverage means you spend less time fiddling with settings and more time catching fish. It’s the ultimate tool for serious anglers who value precision and efficiency.
MOUNT IS NOT COMPATIBLE WITH MINN KOTA QUEST, POWERDRIVE, ULTERRA, TERROVA, OR MOTORGUIDE XI MODELS

title: TTravel Transducer Cover Compatible with Garmin Livescope LVS34, 30% Glass-Fiber Reinforced Sonar Shield Transducer Cover for Impact & Transport Protection, Waterproof ＆ Heat Resistant Protective Case
description:
Engineered with 30% glass fiber-reinforced, heat-stabilized high-performance material, this transducer shield delivers unmatched durability and precision—far surpassing standard ASA plastic or 3D-printed alternatives.
Superior Strength & Impact Resistance - Boasting a tensile strength of 185 MPa and high flexural rigidity, this cover effectively guards against impacts, drops, submerged obstacles, and transport hazards.
Exceptional Heat & Weather Resistance - With a heat deflection temperature of 207°C (405°F) and excellent UV/weather stability, it performs reliably under extreme temperatures and prolonged sun exposure.
Marine-Optimized Material Integrity - Low water absorption (≤1.9%) and high resistance to saltwater corrosion ensure long-term dimensional stability and performance in both freshwater and saltwater environments.
Secure Fit, No Removal Needed - Precision-molded to fit the Garmin LiveScope LVS34 perfectly. Provides continuous protection during transit and fishing—eliminating the need for removal.
Rigorously Tested Latch System - Features a secure attachment mechanism tested to hold firmly through rough water and repeated use.
Easy Tool-Free Installation - Get set up in minutes with a beginner-friendly, tool-free mounting design.
Ideal for anglers who fish hard and demand reliability. Whether you're navigating rocky lakes, brackish estuaries, or open ocean, this cover ensures your Garmin LiveScope stays protected season after season.
